meta.title: Vendor-name masking follows "everyone" or "everyone except super admins"
gaps: Cannot create a round with the specified vendor-masking gates or configure whether user names are shown.
No setup recipe provides three rounds with the required masking variations.
The operations support buyer and vendor actors but not a super-admin actor.
No read-back field or operation exposes masking settings, bid-list vendor names, or buyer user names next to actions.
